details.releaseNotesExcerpt: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes.
